::: {#profile}
Hello! I'm Siyuan Yin, a student at Monash University taking ETC5523 Communicating with Data. Through this course, I am learning to turn research findings into clear data stories using writing, tables and visualisations.

This website shares my coursework and data stories. My current project explores healthcare-associated infections in Germany and explains why hospital and population measures can give different perspectives on infection burden. It also examines why infection frequency alone does not capture the full impact on health.
:::
